bullets.text: French Police Raid X Offices - **Elon Musk** summoned for questioning amid investigation into deepfakes and data fraud.
Apple Discontinues Upgrade Program - **Apple** ends the iPhone Upgrade Program in the UK, introducing a new finance option.
Motorola's Android Update Issues - **Motorola** ships new budget phones with outdated Android 15, lacking upgrade promises.
Skyryse Secures $300M Funding - Aviation startup **Skyryse** raises funds to enhance flight automation systems.
Intel Enters GPU Market - **Intel** announces plans to produce GPUs, challenging **Nvidia**'s dominance.
Apple Integrates AI in Xcode - **Apple** adds **OpenAI** and **Anthropic** coding agents to Xcode for enhanced development.
Microsoft's AI Licensing Hub - **Microsoft** develops an AI content licensing marketplace for publishers and developers.
Lotus Health Raises $35M - **Lotus Health** secures funding for an AI-driven healthcare service providing free consultations.
